zh: 我能试穿一下这条牛仔裤吗？
en: Can I {try on|try} these jeans?

zh: 你去那家新开的奥特莱斯逛过了吗？
en: Have you {checked out|been to|seen|visited|tried} that new outlet store yet?

zh: 演唱会门票十分钟就卖光了。
en: The concert tickets {sold out|sold|went} in ten minutes.

zh: 鞋子太小了，所以我拿去退了。
en: I {took back|returned|sent back|brought back} the shoes because they were too small.

zh: 买新手机之前，值得多逛几家比比价。
en: It's worth {shopping around|looking around} before you buy a new phone.

zh: 她给妈妈挑了一件很可爱的礼物。
en: She {picked out|chose|picked|found|bought|got|selected} a lovely present for her mum.

zh: 我在找一件防水夹克。
en: I'm {looking for|after|hunting for|shopping for} a waterproof jacket.

zh: 上周的日用品是谁付的钱？
en: Who {paid for|bought|got} the groceries last week?

zh: 这些小额消费一个月下来加起来真不少。
en: These small purchases really {add up|mount up} over a month.

zh: 您一共是四十五块。
en: Your total {comes to|is} forty-five dollars.

zh: 收银员录错了价格。
en: The cashier {rang up|charged|entered|put through|scanned|typed in|keyed in} the wrong price.

zh: 队排得太长，我就把巧克力放回去了。
en: I {put back|left|put down} the chocolate because the queue was too long.

zh: 夏天来之前我们囤了很多防晒霜。
en: We {stocked up on|loaded up on|bought} sunscreen before summer.

zh: 因为盒子破了，他们给便宜了百分之十。
en: They {knocked off|took off} ten percent because the box was damaged.

zh: 新靴子要穿几个星期才能磨合好。
en: It takes a few weeks to {break in|wear in} new boots.

zh: 这件衬衫配这条裤子吗？
en: Does this shirt {go with|match|work with} these trousers?

zh: 孩子们的校鞋已经穿不下了。
en: The kids have already {grown out of|outgrown} their school shoes.

zh: 我只是随便看看，谢谢。
en: I'm just {looking around|browsing|looking|having a look}, thanks.

zh: 上周末我们狠下心花大钱买了一张新沙发。
en: Last weekend we {splashed out on|splurged on} a new couch.

zh: 你能帮我留一双九码的吗？
en: Could you {put aside|set aside|hold|keep|save|put away|reserve} a pair in size nine for me?

zh: 商店都在借橄榄球世界杯大赚一笔。
en: Shops are {cashing in on|making money from|profiting from} the Rugby World Cup.

zh: 我进便利店买瓶牛奶，马上出来。
en: I'll just {nip in|pop in|duck in|run in} and grab some milk from the dairy.

zh: 封城前大家都在抢购卫生纸。
en: People were {buying up|snapping up|panic-buying|buying} toilet paper before the lockdown.

zh: 她帮我挑了一件很好看的衬衫。
en: She {picked out|chose|selected|found} a nice shirt for me.

zh: 圣诞节过后销量通常会下滑。
en: Sales usually {drop off|fall off|slow down|drop|fall|decline|go down} after Christmas.

zh: 别磨蹭了，商店十分钟后就关门了。
en: Don't {hang about|hang around|dawdle}. The shop closes in ten minutes.

zh: 你们早上几点开门？
en: What time do you {open up|open} in the morning?

zh: 我们这边的录像带店几年前就倒闭了。
en: Our local video shop {closed down|shut down|closed|shut} years ago.

zh: 他想把假手表当真货卖。
en: He tried to {pass off} fake watches as genuine ones.

zh: 他们在Countdown派发免费试吃品。
en: They were {giving out|handing out} free samples at Countdown.

zh: 我投诉之后，只收到了一封敷衍了事的模板回复。
en: When I complained, I got {fobbed off} with a template reply.

zh: 你能顺路去小卖部买点牛奶吗？
en: Can you {call in|pop in|drop in|stop|stop in|stop off} at the dairy and grab some milk?

zh: 如果夹克不合身，我能拿回来退吗？
en: Can I {bring back|return|take back} the jacket if it doesn't fit?

zh: 人们在店外排了两个小时的队买新手机。
en: People {lined up|queued|queued up} for two hours outside the shop for the new phone.

zh: 别光凭网上的照片来判断。
en: Don't {go by|rely on|trust|judge by} the photos online.

zh: 这家店进口商品加价大概四成。
en: This shop {marks up} imported goods by about forty percent.

zh: 不好意思，那个尺码已经卖完了。
en: Sorry, we've {sold out of|run out of} that size.

zh: 这些夹克都打了五折。
en: All the jackets have been {marked down|reduced|discounted} by fifty percent.

zh: 我买手机时，他们免费送了一个手机壳。
en: They {threw in|chucked in|included|added} a free case when I bought the phone.

zh: 买大一点吧，他长大了就能穿了。
en: Buy it a bit big. He'll {grow into} it.

zh: 结账的时候他们又加了十块钱运费。
en: They {added on|added|charged} ten dollars for shipping at the checkout.

zh: 我已经把选择缩小到两款手机了。
en: I've {narrowed down} my choice to two phones.

zh: 那些打折的鞋几分钟就被抢光了。
en: The discounted shoes were {snapped up|bought up} within minutes.

zh: 有人在接待您吗？
en: Are you being {seen to|served|helped|looked after}?

zh: 商店们都在为圣诞节做准备。
en: The shops are {gearing up for|getting ready for|preparing for} Christmas.

zh: 把已经买过的东西划掉。
en: {Cross off|Tick off|Cross out|Strike off} anything we've already bought.

zh: 我把裙子拿去把腰改小了。
en: I had the dress {taken in} at the waist.

zh: 我的旧鞋子快散架了。
en: My old shoes are {falling apart|coming apart}.

zh: 他们没有蓝色的了，我只好将就买了灰色的。
en: They didn't have blue, so I {settled for|made do with|went with|chose|took|got} grey.

zh: 我在那家店被坑了，一根数据线卖八十块！
en: I got {ripped off|overcharged|scammed|fleeced} at that shop. Eighty dollars for a cable!

zh: 东西都在购物车里了，点这里结账。
en: Your items are in the cart. Click here to {check out|pay}.
